answer: Physical-Sensor Attestation Ledger. Each agent identity must periodically submit a reading from a tamper-resistant sensor package—glacier melt rate, tundra soil temperature, jade spectral reflectance—whose cryptographic chip signs the measurement and its geolocation. The ledger rejects any identity submitting identical readings or readings from a location already claimed. An attacker faking N identities must physically deploy N distinct sensor packages across N distinct sites, so cost scales linearly with fake count and each unit is detectable hardware.
